name: @mpd-dsh/mpd-tui
description: DSH-TUI native surfaces for the @mpd-dsh/mpd bundle: keyed status line, transcript renderers, /settings section, full-screen board scene, /mpd command + command tree, keyboard shortcuts, mediated dialogs, and the ready-but-not-activated decision-event seam

scripts.build: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && bun build packages/mpd-tui-plugin/src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile packages/mpd-tui-plugin/dist/index.js
